question: With which of the following sports is Ezra Cup associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Polo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Ezra Cup is one of the oldest and most prestigious polo tournaments in India.
 
• It was first instituted in 1880 by the Calcutta Polo Club, which is one of the oldest polo clubs in the world.
 
• The tournament is named after Sir David Ezra, a prominent Jewish businessman and philanthropist in Calcutta.
 
• The Ezra Cup has a rich history and is an important event in the Indian polo calendar, attracting top players and teams from around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Polo**

 
 
• Polo is a team sport played on horseback where the objective is to score goals against an opposing team.
 
• Players score by driving a small white ball into the opposing team's goal using a long-handled mallet.
 
• The traditional sport of polo originated in Persia (Iran) and has a history dating back over 2,000 years.
 
• Modern polo is played in over 77 countries, with professional leagues and tournaments held worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Equestrian Show Jumping**
 
 
• Equestrian show jumping is a part of horse riding sports where riders on horseback aim to jump over a series of obstacles within a set time.
 
• The sport requires a combination of horse training, rider skills, and precision.
 
• It is one of the three equestrian disciplines featured at the Olympic Games.
 
 
 
• **Foot Volleyball (Sepak Takraw)**
 
 
• Sepak Takraw is a sport native to Southeast Asia, combining elements of soccer and volleyball.
 
• Players use their feet, knees, chest, and head to hit a rattan ball over a net.
 
• The game is typically played with three players on each side and requires agility, coordination, and precise ball control.
 
 
 
• **Rugby**
 
 
• Rugby is a team sport that originated in England and is played with an oval-shaped ball.
 
• There are two main types of rugby: Rugby Union and Rugby League, each with its own set of rules.
 
• The game involves running with the ball, passing, and tackling to score points by grounding the ball over the opponent's goal line or kicking it through their goalposts.
